claims.statement: Cedar Bluff Logistics Center is identified as the largest asset in the comparable set, at 412,000 square feet.

citations.quote: Cedar Bluff Logistics Center, the largest asset in the comparable set at 412,000 square feet, closed in May 2025

claims.statement: The comps spreadsheet confirms Cedar Bluff Logistics Center's building area as 412,000 SF, which is larger than every other property listed in the comp set (Northgate Business Park 148,500 SF, Meridian Holdings Plaza 92,300 SF, Aurelia Corporate Campus 205,000 SF, Sablewood Retail Court 68,400 SF, Fenwick Distribution Hub 356,800 SF, Ridgeline Office Commons 121,600 SF, Thornfield Industrial Park 289,500 SF, Cobalt Harbor Mixed-Use 174,200 SF, and Wrenfield Business Center 133,700 SF).
